name: i18n-strings-and-catalogs
description: Puts all visible text in react-intl catalogs - semantic keys, CLDR plurals, Intl polyfills, parity. Use when adding UI text or a hard-coded string, a message key, a plural, a translation or a language (i18n). Not for RTL (rtl-and-direction).
